purpose: No-fit reference-quality sensitivity audit; cannot attribute total model error to flagged rows.

predeclared_configuration.satellite_stratum: minimum count over all 11 coordinate endpoints i-10 through i, inclusive
predeclared_configuration.reference_speed_means: actual-dt-weighted left-endpoint means over raw rows i-10 through i-1
predeclared_configuration.coordinate_speed: great-circle endpoint chord distance / actual elapsed time * 3.6
predeclared_configuration.coordinate_path_speed: sum of 10 consecutive great-circle coordinate steps / actual elapsed time * 3.6
predeclared_configuration.time_handling: VBOX seconds-of-day; unwrap only backward changes larger than 12 hours as midnight, matching loader convention; reject nonfinite, nonpositive, irregular cadence, or non-1s duration separately
predeclared_configuration.selection: all 10-row intervals; no speed/model-error filtering; no change to benchmark exclusions
predeclared_configuration.zero_satellite_overlap_flag: raw reference column 0 equals zero; satellite count is not treated as a complete validity mask

observed_interpretation_caveats.satellite_encoding_caveat: Strata use the raw numeric field literally. General .VBO documentation describes +128 DGPS and +64 brake-trigger flags; applicability to this exact IO-VNBD CSV export remains unverified. >=8 is not certified high-quality GNSS.
observed_interpretation_caveats.strict_tolerance_caveat: The 22 rejected intervals arise around two timestamps nominally offset by 0.001 s: floating subtraction exceeds the inclusive 0.001 s tolerance by less than 1e-11 s. They are retained separately as strict-float tolerance flags, not evidence of material time gaps. No timestamps or benchmark exclusions are changed.

online_annotation_check.paper_statement: GPS communication difficulties were encountered; row indices are described as available in a file titled GPS outages.
online_annotation_check.caveat: No separately tracked matching annotation found in current tree. ZIP archive contents and historical revisions not inspected. No downloads made in this follow-up audit.
